_instructions: This file controls all game content. Edit it using Claude Desktop by asking Claude to add, remove, or change scenarios. Each scenario has a type: 'choice' or 'spot'. See CONTENT_GUIDE.md for full instructions.

coach.name: Coach Zara
encouragements: That's exactly what a pro would do! ⭐
corrections: Good try! Think about who has more space. 💭
Almost! Look for the open player next time. 👀
Nice effort! The goal was open on that one. 🥅
Keep going! You'll spot it quicker next time. 💪
So close! Think about where the defender is. 🤔
Good attempt! Always look forward first. 🔍
Nearly! Check all your options before deciding. 🧠
Don't worry — every decision is a chance to learn! ⚽

scenarios.question: You have the ball near midfield. A defender is running at you fast! What do you do?

choices.text: Pass to Emma on the left
choices.explanation: Emma is wide open with no defenders near her. Great vision!

choices.text: Try to dribble past the defender
choices.explanation: The defender is too close — you'd likely lose the ball!

choices.text: Pass to Sofia on the right
choices.explanation: Sofia has a defender right next to her. Emma was the better option.

choices.text: Kick it out of bounds
choices.explanation: We never give up possession on purpose when there's a free teammate!

scenarios.question: You're inside the penalty box with the ball. The goalkeeper moved to the left side. Where do you shoot?

choices.text: Shoot to the right side of the goal
choices.explanation: The keeper moved left, so the right side is wide open. Smart shooting!

choices.text: Shoot to the left where the keeper is
choices.explanation: Always shoot away from the goalkeeper — aim for the open side!

choices.text: Pass back to a midfielder
choices.explanation: You're in a great shooting position! Take the shot when you have a clear chance.

choices.text: Dribble closer first
choices.explanation: You're already in range — taking more touches gives defenders time to recover!

scenarios.question: The other team has the ball near your goal. Your teammate is between you and the attacker. What should you do?

choices.text: Stay in position and cover the space behind Jess
choices.explanation: Great defensive thinking! If the attacker gets past Jess, you're the last line of defense.

choices.text: Run forward to help Jess tackle
choices.explanation: If both you and Jess go for the ball, the attacker can pass and beat you both!

choices.text: Run towards your own goal
choices.explanation: Stay goal-side but don't retreat too far — hold your position and be ready.

choices.text: Call for the ball to start an attack
choices.explanation: We're defending right now — focus on stopping their attack first!

scenarios.question: Tap the teammate who is most open to receive a pass!
scenarios.explanation: Anna on the left had no defenders near her — she was the open option!

scenarios.question: You're being pressed by two defenders. You have two seconds to decide — where does the ball go?

choices.text: Pass to Ria — she's closest
choices.explanation: Closest doesn't always mean best! A defender is right next to Ria.

choices.text: Pass forward to Tess
choices.explanation: Excellent! Tess is in space and moving forward — great vision under pressure!

choices.text: Pass back to Kim
choices.explanation: Kim is open too, but playing backwards when Tess is free going forward loses momentum.

choices.text: Hold the ball and wait
choices.explanation: Two defenders pressing means you must release the ball quickly — trust your teammates!

scenarios.question: Quick! Tap the MOST DANGEROUS attacker your team needs to mark!
scenarios.explanation: ATK2 is closest to goal with a clear path — she needed marking first!

scenarios.question: You're one-on-one with the goalkeeper! She's coming out fast. What's the best move?

choices.text: Shoot early before she reaches you
choices.explanation: When the keeper comes out, shoot early while you still have angle — brilliant composure!

choices.text: Try to dribble around the keeper
choices.explanation: She's coming fast — dribbling takes too long. A quick shot is better here.

choices.text: Pass wide to Faye
choices.explanation: Faye is an option, but you have a clear shooting chance — take it with confidence!

choices.text: Stop and wait for her to commit
choices.explanation: If you wait too long, she'll close the angle completely. Be decisive!

scenarios.question: Your team has a corner kick. You're in the box. Where's the best place to stand?

choices.text: Stand at the far post, away from defenders
choices.explanation: The far post is often left unmarked. Great movement to find space!

choices.text: Stand in the middle of the goal mouth with everyone else
choices.explanation: That's where defenders are watching. Find space away from them!

choices.text: Stand outside the box and wait
choices.explanation: You want to be ready to receive and score — get into the box!

choices.text: Stand right next to the goalkeeper
choices.explanation: The keeper controls that area. Move away from her to find space!

scenarios.question: You receive the ball with your back to the opponent's goal. A defender is right behind you. What do you do?

choices.text: Lay it off to Jade who is beside you
choices.explanation: Smart! Laying the ball off quickly to a nearby teammate keeps possession and relieves pressure.

choices.text: Try to turn and take on the defender
choices.explanation: Turning into a tight defender is risky — you could lose the ball easily!

choices.text: Hold the ball and wait for someone to call
choices.explanation: With a defender on your back, holding too long means you'll get tackled. Move it quickly!

choices.text: Kick it long forward without looking
choices.explanation: Kicking blind can give the ball straight to their defenders. Check your options first!

scenarios.question: An attacker is running at you with the ball. What is the best way to defend?

choices.text: Stay on your feet, slow her down, and wait for help
choices.explanation: Staying on your feet and being patient is the best defending — don't dive in!

choices.text: Dive in and try to kick the ball away
choices.explanation: Diving in is risky! If you miss, the attacker is free to run at goal.

choices.text: Back away as fast as possible
choices.explanation: Backing off too much gives the attacker space to shoot. Stay close but controlled.

choices.text: Run past her to get to the ball
choices.explanation: Running past the attacker leaves the goal wide open behind you!

scenarios.question: Your team is attacking and you don't have the ball. Where should you move to be most helpful?

choices.text: Find a gap between the defenders and call for the ball
choices.explanation: Creating space between defenders gives your teammate a great passing option. Brilliant movement!

choices.text: Stand still and watch the play
choices.explanation: Always keep moving when your team has the ball — make yourself an option!

choices.text: Run back towards your own half
choices.explanation: Your team is attacking — stay forward and look for space to receive!

choices.text: Run to where Priya already is
choices.explanation: Bunching together makes it easy for defenders. Spread out to create more options!

scenarios.question: Your team is defending. Tap the teammate who is in the WORST position right now!
scenarios.explanation: Liv is way out on the right with no attacker to mark — she needs to come in and help defend the middle!

scenarios.question: You're just outside the penalty box with the ball and no defender is close. What do you do?

choices.text: Take a shot at goal — you have space!
choices.explanation: You have time, space, and you're in range — take the shot with confidence!

choices.text: Wait for a defender to come before deciding
choices.explanation: Waiting gives defenders time to close you down. Shoot while you have space!

choices.text: Pass sideways to Cleo
choices.explanation: Cleo is in a similar position and no closer to goal — you have the best shot right now!

choices.text: Dribble backwards away from goal
choices.explanation: Never go backwards when you have a clear shooting chance — be brave and shoot!

scenarios.question: The other team is about to take a free kick near the edge of your box. Where do you stand?

choices.text: Get into the defensive wall to block the shot
choices.explanation: Standing in the wall helps block direct shots at goal. Great defensive awareness!

choices.text: Run forward to press the player taking the kick
choices.explanation: You can't press during a free kick — you must stay back until the ball is played.

choices.text: Stand near the halfway line in case of a counter-attack
choices.explanation: Your team needs all defenders near the box — stay close to protect the goal!

choices.text: Stand behind the goalkeeper
choices.explanation: Behind the keeper is out of play — you need to be in the wall or marking an attacker.

scenarios.question: Your team just won the ball. Tap the teammate who is in the best position to start the attack!
scenarios.explanation: Dani is ahead of the ball, wide open on the left, with space to run at goal — the perfect outlet!

scenarios.question: Your team loses the ball in the opponent's half. What should you do immediately?

choices.text: Sprint back towards your own half immediately
choices.explanation: Transitioning quickly when you lose the ball stops counter-attacks before they start. Great discipline!

choices.text: Stay forward and wait for your team to win it back
choices.explanation: Staying up when your team loses the ball leaves space for the opponent to attack through.

choices.text: Argue with your teammate about the mistake
choices.explanation: Focus on the game! Sprint back first, talk about it at half-time.

choices.text: Walk back slowly to save energy
choices.explanation: Counter-attacks happen in seconds — you need to sprint back, not walk!

scenarios.question: The goalkeeper on your team has the ball and is looking to start an attack. Where should you move to help?

choices.text: Run wide to give the keeper a clear passing lane
choices.explanation: Moving wide creates a simple short pass for the keeper and gets the attack going quickly!

choices.text: Stay in the middle where you are
choices.explanation: You're in a crowded central area. Moving wide gives the keeper more options!

choices.text: Run towards the keeper to get the ball
choices.explanation: Running towards the keeper brings your defender with you and makes the pass harder!

choices.text: Sprint into the opponent's half straight away
choices.explanation: You're too far away for a long kick to reach you safely. Stay closer and build up the play!

scenarios.question: Tap the teammate who has the most space to receive a through ball!
scenarios.explanation: Lena is running into space up the middle with no defender close — a perfectly timed through ball would send her clear!

scenarios.question: Two attackers are running towards your goal and there's only you to stop them. What do you do?

choices.text: Stay central, delay both attackers, and don't commit
choices.explanation: By staying central you cover both options and force the attacker to make a risky decision. Smart defending!

choices.text: Sprint at the player with the ball and tackle hard
choices.explanation: If you dive in and miss, the other attacker is free to score. Stay on your feet!

choices.text: Mark the attacker without the ball
choices.explanation: The player with the ball is the danger — keep your eye on her first!

choices.text: Retreat all the way to the goal line
choices.explanation: Retreating too much lets them get very close before shooting. Stay between them and slow them down!

scenarios.question: You receive a cross in the penalty box. The ball is coming to your weaker foot. What do you do?

choices.text: Shoot first time with your weaker foot — you're in a great spot!
choices.explanation: Brave! In the box, shooting quickly with any foot is better than hesitating and losing the chance.

choices.text: Wait and try to switch the ball to your stronger foot
choices.explanation: Taking extra touches in the box gives defenders time to block you. Shoot quickly!

choices.text: Pass back out to Kit
choices.explanation: You're in a prime scoring position — believe in yourself and take the shot!

choices.text: Try to control the ball and dribble towards the keeper
choices.explanation: Dribbling in a crowded box is risky. First-time shots catch goalkeepers off-guard!

scenarios.question: Your team has a throw-in in your own half. The opponents are pressing high. What's the safest option?

choices.text: Short throw to Gabi who has dropped free behind you
choices.explanation: Gabi has space and you can build from the back safely — great awareness!

choices.text: Long throw forward into a crowded midfield
choices.explanation: Throwing long into pressure risks losing the ball. Keep it simple and safe!

choices.text: Throw it straight to a defender being pressed
choices.explanation: Throwing into pressure is risky. Find the free player first!

choices.text: Wait and hope someone calls for it
choices.explanation: Look quickly and find the free player yourself — don't stand still with the ball!

scenarios.question: Your team is about to lose the ball. Tap the defender who is out of position!
scenarios.explanation: Vee is stranded on the far right with three attackers threatening central — she needs to get back into position fast!

scenarios.question: You're dribbling down the wing and the defender is blocking your path to cross. What's the smartest move?

choices.text: Cut back and pass to Nell in the middle
choices.explanation: The defender blocked the wing — cutting back to Nell keeps possession and keeps the attack alive. Clever!

choices.text: Try to beat the defender and cross anyway
choices.explanation: The defender is well-placed — the cut-back to Nell is the smarter option here.

choices.text: Stop and hold the ball until someone makes a run
choices.explanation: Stopping in the corner lets defenders surround you. Keep the ball moving!

choices.text: Pass backwards all the way to your goalkeeper
choices.explanation: Going all the way back loses attacking momentum when Nell is available in a great spot!

scenarios.question: The ball is on the opposite side of the field from you. How should you position yourself?

choices.text: Move slightly towards the centre, ready to switch play
choices.explanation: Tucking in slightly when the ball is far away means you're ready if the ball is switched to your side. Great shape!

choices.text: Stay as wide as possible on the right
choices.explanation: Being too wide when the ball is on the opposite side means you're too far from the action if it switches.

choices.text: Run to the left side where the ball is
choices.explanation: If you all crowd one side, there's no one available when the ball switches. Hold your position!

choices.text: Drop back to help defend
choices.explanation: Your team is attacking — stay forward so there's an option when they switch the play to your side!

scenarios.question: The goalkeeper kicked the ball long. Tap the teammate who is best placed to win the header!
scenarios.explanation: Drew is right where the ball is dropping and has a step on the nearest defender — she's best placed to win the header!

scenarios.question: The other team's striker is running towards you with the ball but hasn't looked up yet. What do you do?

choices.text: Get close and show her towards the outside
choices.explanation: Showing an attacker towards the outside moves the danger away from the centre of goal. Textbook defending!

choices.text: Back off and give her space to shoot
choices.explanation: Giving too much space lets the attacker get a clean shot off. Stay close and make it hard!

choices.text: Slide tackle immediately
choices.explanation: A slide tackle when she hasn't committed is too risky — you might miss and foul her!

choices.text: Shout at your goalkeeper to come out
choices.explanation: The keeper should stay on her line — it's your job to deal with this. Stay focused!

scenarios.question: Your team wins a penalty kick! You're about to take it. The keeper is standing in the centre. What's your plan?

choices.text: Pick a corner and shoot with power and accuracy
choices.explanation: Picking a corner and committing to it is the best penalty strategy — keepers can't cover the corners if you're accurate!

choices.text: Wait to see which way the keeper dives, then shoot the other way
choices.explanation: Waiting for the keeper to move slows you down and makes the kick less powerful. Decide before you run up!

choices.text: Aim straight down the middle
choices.explanation: Shooting down the middle can work but is easily saved if the keeper stands still. Aim for a corner!

choices.text: Try a soft chip down the middle
choices.explanation: A chip is very risky — if the keeper doesn't dive, she'll easily save it. Shoot with confidence!

scenarios.question: You have the ball at your feet and your teammate is calling for it — but an opponent is between you both. What do you do?

choices.text: Pass to Nadia who is open on the left instead
choices.explanation: Even though Lexi called, the defender is blocking that pass. Finding the open player is smarter!

choices.text: Force the pass through to Lexi anyway
choices.explanation: A defender is right in the way — the pass will be intercepted! Find the free player.

choices.text: Dribble towards the defender to create space
choices.explanation: Nadia is free right now — pass to her before the chance disappears!

choices.text: Shout at Lexi to move
choices.explanation: There's no time to shout instructions — play the easy ball to Nadia and keep moving!

scenarios.question: Your team just scored! Tap the teammate you should hug first — she made the key assist run!
scenarios.explanation: Rue made a brilliant run to the far post to pull the defender away and create the space for the goal — she made it happen!

scenarios.question: You're playing as a striker and your team is defending a corner. Where should you position yourself?

choices.text: Stay near the halfway line ready for a quick counter-attack
choices.explanation: As a striker, your job on corners is to be the counter-attack threat. Stay forward and be ready to run!

choices.text: Go back into your own box to help defend
choices.explanation: Your team has defenders for that! Your job as striker is to be ready for the counter.

choices.text: Stand right next to the corner flag to block the kick
choices.explanation: You can't block a corner kick — that's not a rule you can use here!

choices.text: Go to the edge of the penalty box and wait
choices.explanation: If the ball is cleared, it probably won't reach that far. Get into a real counter-attack position!

scenarios.question: You're through on goal but you're running at full speed. The goalkeeper is rushing out. What do you do?

choices.text: Stay calm and chip the ball over the rushing keeper
choices.explanation: A chip over a rushing keeper is a brilliant finish — it uses her own momentum against her!

choices.text: Try to run around the goalkeeper
choices.explanation: At full speed it's very hard to go around a keeper who's already rushing out. The chip is smarter!

choices.text: Blast the ball as hard as possible
choices.explanation: Blasting into a keeper who's rushing towards you often leads to a block. Stay calm and chip!

choices.text: Pass sideways to Juno at the last second
choices.explanation: Juno is a backup option, but you have the best chance right now — back yourself and go for goal!

scenarios.question: Tap the opponent who is completely unmarked and most dangerous right now!
scenarios.explanation: ATK3 has no one near her on the right side and is in a great position to receive the ball and shoot — she needs marking immediately!

scenarios.question: The other team's winger is running fast down the side with the ball. You're the last defender. What do you do?

choices.text: Stay between the attacker and the goal, slow her down
choices.explanation: As the last defender, your goal is to delay and protect the goal — not to win the ball at all costs!

choices.text: Sprint at the ball and try to tackle
choices.explanation: If you miss the tackle as last defender, she's free to score. Don't gamble — delay!

choices.text: Foul her to stop the attack
choices.explanation: Fouling could give away a penalty or free kick in a dangerous area. Stay on your feet!

choices.text: Let her go and shout for offside
choices.explanation: You can't just let her go — stay close and force her wide, away from goal!

scenarios.question: You're in midfield. You have the ball but three options: go forward, sideways, or back. The pressure is low. What do you choose?

choices.text: Pass forward to Rena who is ahead of you
choices.explanation: When you have space and a teammate forward, progress the ball! Rena is open and moving forward — brilliant decision!

choices.text: Pass sideways to Cori to recycle possession
choices.explanation: Sideways is fine when under pressure, but Rena is free going forward — always look to progress first!

choices.text: Pass back to Petra to keep it safe
choices.explanation: Playing backwards when you have a forward pass available slows the attack. Look forward first!

choices.text: Dribble forward yourself
choices.explanation: Dribbling when a teammate is free is usually slower — pass and move for better team play!

scenarios.question: Your team has a goal kick. Tap the teammate in the best position to receive it safely!
scenarios.explanation: Willa has dropped to the left side and has no one near her — she's the safest and clearest option for the goal kick!

scenarios.question: Your team is about to defend a goal kick from the other team. Where should you stand?

choices.text: Press up close to their player to try to win the ball in the air
choices.explanation: Getting tight to your opponent and challenging for the ball means you might win it and start an attack. Great pressing!

choices.text: Stay back near your own goal just in case
choices.explanation: Dropping too deep gives the other team too much space to build their attack freely.

choices.text: Stand at the halfway line and wait
choices.explanation: Waiting at the halfway line lets their team receive the ball and run at you. Press up and challenge!

choices.text: Run behind your own goalkeeper
choices.explanation: That's too far back! You need to be in a position to challenge for the ball or be ready to defend.

scenarios.question: You're in midfield with the ball. One teammate is running into space ahead of you, one is standing still. Who do you pass to?

choices.text: Pass to Bea who is making the run into space
choices.explanation: Always play to the moving player! Bea is running into space — your pass gives her momentum.

choices.text: Pass to Mona who is standing still
choices.explanation: Mona is standing still and has a defender close. Pass to the player making the run!

choices.text: Dribble forward and decide later
choices.explanation: Bea's run is happening now — if you wait, the defender will cover her. Pass quickly!

choices.text: Turn and pass backwards
choices.explanation: You have a teammate running forward into space — use her! That's a clear attacking opportunity.

scenarios.question: Your team wins the ball and starts attacking. You're a defender. What do you do?

choices.text: Stay back and hold your defensive position
choices.explanation: Defenders must stay back even in attack! You protect the team against a quick counter-attack.

choices.text: Sprint forward to join the attack
choices.explanation: If you charge forward and your team loses the ball, the opponents have a clear run at goal. Hold your shape!

choices.text: Cheer your teammates from the halfway line
choices.explanation: Stay in your defensive position — close enough to react if your team loses the ball.

choices.text: Walk forward slowly to save energy
choices.explanation: Stay disciplined in your position. Walking forward still leaves space behind you!

scenarios.question: You receive the ball at the edge of the box with your back to goal. Two defenders are close. What's your best move?

choices.text: Flick the ball wide to Ola or Tia who are both free
choices.explanation: With two defenders on you, laying it wide to an unmarked teammate is the smartest play. Great composure!

choices.text: Turn and shoot through the two defenders
choices.explanation: Two defenders in your way makes this very hard. The wide pass to a free player is much cleaner.

choices.text: Try to dribble past both defenders
choices.explanation: Two-vs-one dribbling near goal is very risky. Use your free teammates!

choices.text: Fall down and hope for a foul
choices.explanation: Play the game properly — use your open teammates instead!

scenarios.question: Your team is attacking. Tap the teammate who is in the best place to score if you cross the ball now!
scenarios.explanation: Cleo is at the far post with no defender near her — a cross to that area gives her a clear chance to score!

scenarios.question: You are a winger and your team has just kicked off at the start of the game. Where should you start?

choices.text: Spread wide on your side of the pitch
choices.explanation: Wingers stretch the play wide. This pulls defenders apart and creates space for your team!

choices.text: Crowd into the centre with your teammates
choices.explanation: Bunching in the middle makes it easier for the other team to defend. Spread the play wide!

choices.text: Stand in the opponent's goal area waiting for a pass
choices.explanation: That's too far ahead — you need to be in a position to receive the ball first!

choices.text: Run straight to the other team's goalkeeper
choices.explanation: The game has just kicked off — build the play from the centre first!

scenarios.question: Your goalkeeper catches the ball after a corner kick. What should you do to help restart the attack?

choices.text: Make a run into space so the keeper has an easy outlet
choices.explanation: After catching a corner, the keeper wants to restart quickly. Give her a clear passing option by running into space!

choices.text: Stay where you are — the keeper will sort it out
choices.explanation: Your team needs options to restart! Move and create a passing lane for the keeper.

choices.text: Run towards the keeper to be closer to the ball
choices.explanation: Running towards the keeper brings your marker with you and blocks the passing lane!

choices.text: Stand near the opponent's goal ready to counter
choices.explanation: You're too far away for a safe pass from the keeper. Stay closer to help restart the play.

scenarios.question: Your team is under pressure. Tap the teammate who is in the safest position for you to pass to right now!
scenarios.explanation: Fran has dropped into space wide left with no defender close — a simple, safe pass to her relieves the pressure!

scenarios.question: You're on the wing with the ball. Your striker is making a run behind the defenders. What do you do?

choices.text: Play a through ball into the space behind the defence for Pia
choices.explanation: Pia is making a perfect run in behind — a well-timed through ball puts her clean through on goal!

choices.text: Cross the ball to the near post
choices.explanation: Pia is running in behind, not towards the near post. Play the through ball into the space she's running into!

choices.text: Dribble inside and shoot yourself
choices.explanation: Pia has a much better position — use her run! Assist opportunities are just as valuable as goals.

choices.text: Pass back to Dot and start again
choices.explanation: Pia's run is happening right now — if you delay, the defenders will catch up with her!

scenarios.question: The opposition wins a corner. You're a midfielder. Where do you go?

choices.text: Get into the penalty box and mark an opponent
choices.explanation: As a midfielder defending a corner, you must pick up a player in the box and stop them heading at goal!

choices.text: Stay in the middle of the pitch
choices.explanation: Your team needs everyone defending the corner — you have to mark someone in the box!

choices.text: Stand near the halfway line for a counter-attack
choices.explanation: You can leave one striker up, but as a midfielder you're needed in the box to defend!

choices.text: Run to the corner flag to block the kick
choices.explanation: You can't block a corner kick — get into the box and mark an attacker!

scenarios.question: Your team is defending. Tap the attacker who is in the most dangerous position right now!
scenarios.explanation: ATK2 is in central midfield with clear sight of goal and no one marking her — she must be tracked immediately!

scenarios.question: You get a free kick 25 yards from goal. The wall is set. Where should you aim?

choices.text: Curl the ball around the wall into the far corner
choices.explanation: Bending the ball around the wall into the corner is the best free kick technique — aim for where the keeper can't reach!

choices.text: Blast it straight through the wall
choices.explanation: The wall will block a straight kick. You need to go around or over it!

choices.text: Pass sideways to Ally instead
choices.explanation: This is a great shooting position — take the direct shot! You can always square it next time.

choices.text: Aim directly at the goalkeeper
choices.explanation: Shooting at the keeper is the easiest thing for her to save. Aim for the corners!

scenarios.question: Your team is defending deep. The other team has the ball in midfield with lots of players around you. Where do you go?

choices.text: Drop into a compact defensive line between the ball and your goal
choices.explanation: When defending deep, staying compact and organised in a line makes it very hard for attackers to find a gap!

choices.text: Rush out to press the ball in midfield
choices.explanation: If your whole team rushes out, you leave huge space behind you. Stay compact!

choices.text: Stand right on the goal line to protect it
choices.explanation: Being too deep gives attackers too much space to shoot from. Hold a higher defensive line!

choices.text: Run to mark the player on the far side of the pitch
choices.explanation: Keep your shape — don't chase the ball all over the pitch. Hold your position in the defensive line.

scenarios.question: Your teammate is calling for the ball, but she's closely marked. Another teammate is completely free on the other side. What do you do?

choices.text: Pass to Zuri who is completely free
choices.explanation: Even though Rose called, Zuri has no defender — always pass to the free player!

choices.text: Pass to Rose because she called for it
choices.explanation: Rose is closely marked — that pass would likely be intercepted. Use the free player!

choices.text: Dribble forward yourself
choices.explanation: Zuri is wide open — use her! Passing is almost always faster than dribbling.

choices.text: Hold the ball and wait for Rose to shake her marker
choices.explanation: Zuri is free right now. Don't wait — play the easy ball while you have the chance!

scenarios.question: Tap the teammate who has made the best run and should receive the ball right now!
scenarios.explanation: Nola has made a brilliant diagonal run between the defenders and is free in behind — the perfect through ball target!

scenarios.question: The other team is crossing the ball into your penalty area. You're defending. What do you prioritise?

choices.text: Get goalside of your attacker and try to head the ball clear
choices.explanation: Getting goalside means the attacker can't get between you and the goal. Try to win the header and clear the danger!

choices.text: Stand in front of your goalkeeper so she can't see
choices.explanation: Never block your own goalkeeper — she needs a clear view to either catch the cross or come out for it!

choices.text: Run to the touchline to stop the cross
choices.explanation: The cross is already on its way — you need to defend the ball landing in the box, not the delivery.

choices.text: Let the goalkeeper deal with it alone
choices.explanation: Defenders and the keeper work together. Mark your player tightly so the keeper knows who to leave to you!

scenarios.question: Your team is defending and the ball is in your own half. You're a striker. What should you do?

choices.text: Stay in an advanced position, ready to counter-attack
choices.explanation: As a striker you don't need to defend deep — stay forward and be the counter-attack option when your team wins the ball!

choices.text: Sprint back into your own goal area to help
choices.explanation: Your team has defenders for that! Stay forward so you're ready when your team wins the ball back.

choices.text: Press every opponent with the ball
choices.explanation: Pressing from so far back tires you out. Hold your position and be the attacking outlet.

choices.text: Sit down and rest because you're not involved
choices.explanation: Stay on your toes and ready! The ball can come to you any second on the counter.

scenarios.question: Quick — tap the teammate who is completely free and closest to the opponent's goal!
scenarios.explanation: Aria is in behind the defence right near the goal with no defender near her — the perfect player to receive a through ball!

scenarios.question: A defender is pressing you hard in your own half. What's the smartest pass to relieve pressure?

choices.text: Short pass to Min who has dropped into a wide area
choices.explanation: Min has dropped into a free zone. A short, safe pass relieves the pressure and keeps possession!

choices.text: Try a long ball up the pitch to your striker
choices.explanation: Under this much pressure a long ball is risky — you might give it straight to the other team. Play safe!

choices.text: Pass to Hara who is already being marked
choices.explanation: Hara has a defender close. The safe pass to Min is the much smarter choice right now.

choices.text: Turn and try to dribble past the pressing defender
choices.explanation: Turning in your own half under pressure is very risky! Play the simple pass to Min.

scenarios.question: Your team is winning 1-0 with two minutes left. The other team is attacking. What's the most important thing?

choices.text: Stay disciplined, hold your shape, and don't dive in
choices.explanation: When winning late in a game, patience is key. Stay compact, don't gamble, and run down the clock safely!

choices.text: Try to win the ball back immediately with a tackle
choices.explanation: Diving in with two minutes left risks giving away a penalty or free kick. Be patient!

choices.text: Push forward to score another goal
choices.explanation: Leaving your defensive shape now is dangerous — protect the lead you have!

choices.text: Kick the ball out of bounds to waste time
choices.explanation: This might seem smart but time-wasting in youth football is poor sportsmanship. Defend properly!

scenarios.question: Your team just won the ball in midfield. Tap the teammate who can start a counter-attack immediately!
scenarios.explanation: Petra is in behind the defensive line and facing the opponent's goal — a quick pass to her launches the counter-attack!

scenarios.question: You're through on goal with only the keeper to beat. She's staying on her line. What do you do?

choices.text: Shoot low into a corner before she can react
choices.explanation: Low corners are the hardest for keepers to reach. Staying calm and picking a corner is the best chance!

choices.text: Keep dribbling right up to the keeper
choices.explanation: Getting too close lets the keeper smother the ball. Shoot from distance while you have the angle!

choices.text: Slow down and look at the goal for a long time
choices.explanation: Taking too long lets defenders recover! Be decisive and shoot.

choices.text: Try to dribble around the side of the keeper
choices.explanation: With a clear shot available, going for goal is better than trying to dribble around.

scenarios.question: Your team has the ball. You've been running hard for 10 minutes. What should you still do?

choices.text: Keep moving and look for space to offer a passing option
choices.explanation: Even when you're tired, you must keep moving! Creating passing options is one of the most important things a player can do.

choices.text: Stop and catch your breath — you've earned a rest
choices.explanation: The game doesn't stop when you're tired! Keep moving and do your job for your team.

choices.text: Shout at your teammates to pass the ball to you
choices.explanation: Move into space first, then call for the ball — don't just shout from the same spot!

choices.text: Walk to the side of the pitch and wait
choices.explanation: Your team needs you on the pitch and involved — keep moving even when it's hard!

scenarios.question: The ball is about to be played. Tap the teammate who is most open on the left side!
scenarios.explanation: Zola is wide open on the left with no defender near her — a pass to her stretches the play and creates space!

scenarios.question: You're about to pass the ball. Do you pass to the feet of your teammate or into the space ahead of her?

choices.text: Pass into the space ahead of her so she can run onto it
choices.explanation: When a teammate is running, always pass into the space ahead of her so she can keep moving at full speed!

choices.text: Pass to her feet so she doesn't have to adjust
choices.explanation: Passing to her feet when she's running means she has to stop and collect it — that slows the attack down.

choices.text: Hold the ball and wait for her to stop
choices.explanation: Don't wait — pass now while she's in stride and the space is open!

choices.text: Chip the ball over her head
choices.explanation: A chip over her head is hard to control. A ground pass into the space ahead is the right choice.

scenarios.question: You're defending and the attacker has just played a one-two with a teammate. She's now got the ball and is running at you again. What do you do?

choices.text: Recover your position quickly between her and goal
choices.explanation: Get goal-side of her quickly! The one-two got past you once — now prioritise getting between her and the goal.

choices.text: Chase her teammate who played the pass
choices.explanation: The danger is the player with the ball — track the ball, not the one who already played it!

choices.text: Commit to a slide tackle immediately
choices.explanation: A rash tackle here is risky. Recover your position first and be patient.

choices.text: Stop running — your teammate will cover
choices.explanation: Your team needs you to track back hard! Never give up on a defensive run.

scenarios.question: Your team is attacking. Tap the teammate making the most dangerous run for a goal!
scenarios.explanation: Nina has slipped in behind the last defender and is running towards goal — a well-timed pass puts her clean through!

scenarios.question: Your team's attacking midfielder has the ball in the centre. You're on the right wing. What's your best movement?

choices.text: Make a run in behind the defender to stretch the defence
choices.explanation: Running in behind the right-back forces the defender to retreat and opens space for Caz to play a through ball!

choices.text: Come short and take the ball to feet
choices.explanation: Coming short while Emi is already in the box would make your team too narrow. Run in behind instead!

choices.text: Stay wide and stand still to keep your position
choices.explanation: Movement creates options! A run in behind is much more dangerous than standing still.

choices.text: Swap sides with the left winger
choices.explanation: Unnecessary swapping disrupts your team's shape. Make a run in behind instead — that's what the right wing should do here!

scenarios.question: You get a half-volley chance at the edge of the box. The keeper hasn't set yet. What do you do?

choices.text: Hit it first time before the keeper can get set
choices.explanation: A quick, well-hit half-volley before the keeper sets is one of the hardest shots to save. Trust your instinct and shoot!

choices.text: Control the ball, then shoot
choices.explanation: Taking an extra touch gives the keeper time to set and defenders time to close you. Shoot first time!

choices.text: Pass wide to Fen or Yael
choices.explanation: You're in a brilliant position right now — shoot! Don't give the chance away.

choices.text: Wait for the ball to bounce again before shooting
choices.explanation: Waiting only helps the keeper and defenders. Strike the ball first time while the keeper is unsettled!

scenarios.question: Your team is defending a free kick. Tap the attacker who is most likely to be the target of the kick!
scenarios.explanation: ATK2 is centrally positioned just inside the box — the most dangerous place to receive the ball. She needs to be marked tightly!

scenarios.question: You have the ball and you see the opposing right-back is forward attacking. There's a huge gap left behind her. What do you do?

choices.text: Play a pass into the space on the right for Zin to run onto
choices.explanation: Exploiting the space left by an attacking full-back is brilliant tactical thinking! Play Zin in behind — she has a clear run at goal!

choices.text: Pass to Nour who is closely marked
choices.explanation: Nour is marked — and there's a huge gap on the right! Exploit that space with Zin.

choices.text: Hold the ball and wait
choices.explanation: The full-back will run back if you wait too long. Play the pass to Zin now while the space is there!

choices.text: Dribble forward into the crowded central area
choices.explanation: The gap on the right is the smart option — use Zin's run instead of forcing into a crowded area.

scenarios.question: Your team is defending a throw-in in your own half. Where should you be?

choices.text: Closely mark the nearest opponent to make the throw difficult
choices.explanation: Making the throw-in hard by marking tightly is excellent defending — reduce their options before the ball even comes in!

choices.text: Stand off and give them space to receive
choices.explanation: Giving space in your own half is dangerous. Get tight and make their throw difficult!

choices.text: Run back towards your own goal
choices.explanation: Standing off too deep gives them too much space. Get tighter and be more aggressive!

choices.text: Try to grab the ball from the thrower
choices.explanation: You can't touch the thrower — that would be a foul! Mark the receivers instead.

scenarios.question: Tap the teammate who is in the best position to score from this attack!
scenarios.explanation: Sage is central, close to goal, with no defender between her and the net — she's perfectly placed to receive and shoot!

scenarios.question: Your team is attacking down the left wing. You are the right winger. What is the smartest thing to do?

choices.text: Move to the far post to be ready if the ball is switched
choices.explanation: When your team attacks on the opposite side, getting to the far post means you are ready to head or shoot if the ball comes across. Smart positioning!

choices.text: Run over to the left side to join in
choices.explanation: If you both crowd the left, there is no one on the right! Stay wide and be the option on the far side.

choices.text: Stay exactly where you are and watch
choices.explanation: Movement is always important. Get to the far post so you are a threat if the ball comes across!

choices.text: Drop back to defend in case you lose the ball
choices.explanation: Your team is attacking — stay forward and be a goal threat at the far post!

scenarios.question: You have the ball near the sideline and a defender is pushing you out of play. What do you do?

choices.text: Play a quick inside pass to Obi or Paz before you go out
choices.explanation: Getting the pass off before you are pushed out of play keeps possession for your team. Quick thinking!

choices.text: Try to shield the ball and stay in play
choices.explanation: The defender is pushing you out — you cannot hold on forever. Play the quick pass now!

choices.text: Kick the ball out of play on purpose
choices.explanation: Never give up possession willingly when you have open teammates available!

choices.text: Try to beat the defender and come back inside
choices.explanation: With a defender right on you at the sideline, the quick pass to your open teammates is by far the smartest option.
